title: Compact exhaustion K_p ⊆ interior K_{p+1} of an open set U ⊆ ℝ^N
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^N (= Euclidean N) be open. Then there are sets K_p ⊆ ℝ^N, p ∈ ℕ, such that every K_p is compact, K_p ⊆ U, K_p ⊆ interior K_{p+1}, the sequence is increasing (K_p ⊆ K_q whenever p ≤ q), and ⋃_p K_p = U.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ p, IsCompact (K p)) ∧ (∀ p, K p ⊆ U) ∧ (∀ p, K p ⊆ interior (K (p + 1))) ∧ Monotone K ∧ ⋃ p, K p = U
